business_summary: Wize Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in gaming business in Japan and internationally. It operates game platform. The company engages in the production business of games and digital contents; IP investment development projects; lifestyle Ip business; and digital IP business; and cooking contents business. The company was formerly known as Mobcast Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Wize Inc. in April 2026. Wize Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Wize Inc.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외에서 게임 사업에 참여하고 있습니다. It operates game platform. 회사는 게임 및 디지털 콘텐츠 제작 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. IP investment development projects; 라이프스타일 IP 비즈니스; 디지털 IP 사업; and cooking contents business. 이 회사는 이전에 Mobcast Holdings Inc.로 알려졌으며 2026년 4월에 Wize Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Wize Inc.는 2004년에 설립되었으며 일본 시부야에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
